## MAX_OUTSTANDING_UPLOADS_PER_SUBJECT variable

Most uploads one subject can have outstanding at once: 16.

**Signature:**

```typescript
MAX_OUTSTANDING_UPLOADS_PER_SUBJECT = 16
```

## Remarks

An upload is outstanding from creation until it is consumed or expires. The bound keeps one caller from reserving unbounded upload slots; enough for an operation that writes several files plus a few retries. Creating another fails with `RateLimitedError`<!-- -->, whose `retryAfterSeconds` says when the subject's oldest outstanding upload expires.
